授業概要
キャリア形成に必要な自己分析・自己理解を深め、自らのキャリアについて主体的に考えることを学ぶ。
合理的配慮の下で行うサキドリ‼仕事体験実習を取り入れ、各種準備講座や事前・事後面談、九大卒業生の講演など、キャリアに関する様々なカリキュラムへの参加を通じて自己理解や働くイメージを深めることを目的とする。
Students will deepen their self-analysis and self-understanding—essential for career development—and learn to take a proactive approach to planning their own careers.
The program incorporates the “Sakidori!!” work experience internship, conducted with reasonable accommodations, and aims to help students deepen their self-understanding and develop a clearer vision of their future careers through participation in various career-related activities, including preparatory workshops, pre- and post-internship interviews, and lectures by Kyushu University alumni.
